kind: bounded independent JEV-role review; advisory; freezes nothing
author: opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash (JEV-role reviewer; recorded from the actual model invocation)
authority: advisory input to the research owner; GPT owns the direction decision
headline: No JEV route has yet shown a supported financial edge; R1 is an unselected, untested advisory proposal; the direction owner rejects R1 for now.

direction_owner_decision.reason: R1 has not demonstrated incremental usefulness, and its verdict scoring may conflict with the user's no-classifiers constraint. Compliance is not declared on the user's behalf.
direction_owner_decision.r1_status: untested advisory proposal; selected false; recommended_role null; not implemented
direction_owner_decision.note: This correction authorizes no new API call, no classifier, no price read and no OOS access. It neither implements nor endorses R1.

not_read: raw filings, raw payoff rows, outcomes.sqlite, comparisons.json, pricing_coverage.json, any outcomes.csv or tests.csv
any record inside the reserved 2023-06-01..2023-08-31 window
equity audit outputs (owned by another worker)

api_capability_confirmed_from_local_sour.state: dict; observed keys include supporting_text, disclosure_category, passages
api_capability_confirmed_from_local_sour.free_form_notes: Only the score and choice answer types appear in the local requests and in validate_response. Local request code establishes only the locally implemented score/choice capabilities; it does not establish the provider's full API surface. This review therefore does not claim free-form evaluation is universally unsupported, nor that it is supported. As used locally, JEV is given an explanation in state and asked typed score/choice questions about it.
multi_question_batching_evidence: jev_experiment.py sends 5 score questions in one request
stability_experiment.py sends 10 score questions in one request
risk_composition_audit.py sends 8 choice questions in one request
expanded_guidance_semantics.py mixes choice and score questions
api_capability_confirmed_from_local_sour.validator_note: validate_response rejects any answer type other than Score or Choice; a model or question-set mismatch stops scoring.

supported_financial_edge.reason: Not currently demonstrated: JEV is barred from defining or classifying events; STABILITY is no_candidate; BENCHMARK is 35/39 versus a 35/39 deterministic baseline with no increment; RISK_COMPOSITION is measurement_not_validated; EARNINGS_PAYOFF is a below-floor stopped benchmark whose primary interval is UNAVAILABLE because the sample floor was not met (not a null interval). This is a statement about current evidence, not proof that no non-classifier JEV route could ever work.

guideline_compliant_submission_with_vali.reason: Conditional, not achieved. It requires a component that is actually validated. R1 is a proposal for such a component and has not demonstrated incremental usefulness, so the condition is unmet and no compliance is declared on the user's behalf.

roles.name: Evidence-constrained falsification/consistency auditor over a fixed historical evidence table
roles.endpoint_kind: measurement validity (agreement + incremental correctness), not returns
roles.grade_caveat: advisory projections for an endpoint that has never been run; not results
concrete_evidence: rubric fixes one category, one strategy, all five structures, ordinary-day baseline, nine horizons, costs and the OTM/bucket/entry/sensitivity grid, all already public
reads only public aggregates (EARNINGS_PAYOFF_HORIZONS.json) plus Massive disclosure_category and supporting_text
no event is defined or selected by the verdict, so it stays outside the stop-classifiers rule
numerical-table reasoning is a known weak point, which caps robustness and mechanism grades

roles.name: Evidence-constrained council / multi-judge adjudication of competing explanations
roles.reason: collapses into R1; council aggregation risks circularity and, if confidence-weighted, becomes confidence-as-alpha

roles.name: JEV as a predictor or severity label feeding the sample or strategy choice
roles.reason: disqualified: it is exactly the forbidden classifier; BENCHMARK already shows no incremental accuracy over the simple deterministic baseline

roles.name: Use JEV internal confidence as correctness or alpha
roles.reason: disqualified: confidence is not correctness; STABILITY and BENCHMARK explicitly report high confidence and agreement without incremental predictive value

falsification_role_design.status: proposal only; unselected and untested; recorded to document what was considered, not endorsed
falsification_role_design.endpoint: item-level agreement between JEV's typed falsification verdict and a blinded independent reference on a fixed battery of pre-registered explanations (one per structure), each judged against a frozen historical evidence table
falsification_role_design.evidence_table: public EARNINGS_PAYOFF_HORIZONS.json (five structures, ordinary baseline, horizons, costs, sensitivity) plus Massive disclosure_category and supporting_text
falsification_role_design.blinded_independent_reference: a reference authored without seeing JEV outputs; model-reviewed or human as available, with provenance stated honestly
falsification_role_design.simple_baseline: deterministic keyword-overlap plus recorded-sign rule on the same table
falsification_role_design.latency_benchmark: per-request wall time, p50/p95, judgments/second on the fixed battery
falsification_role_design.robustness_benchmark: paraphrase and option-order perturbation; report verdict stability and abstentions; this is endpoint reliability, not a rerun of the market stability experiment
refusals: no verdict used to pick the category or strategy
no stimulus or threshold chosen from outcomes

financial_track_obligations_consumed_not.costs_and_sensitivity: flat commission, funding and premium-haircut scenarios plus the frozen OTM/bucket/entry/stale grid
financial_track_obligations_consumed_not.note: these remain the financial track's obligations; the JEV role consumes them as fixed table content and does not re-estimate them

rejected_as_cosmetic_or_invalid: cosmetic dressing of an unchanged financial result
circular judging where the reference is derived from JEV

next_action.defensible_next_action: keep the well-argued null write-up the rubric rewards; treat the R1 measurement audit as a conditional, unvalidated candidate, not a validated component
next_action.reason_implementation_possible: the R1 endpoint would read only public aggregates and Massive in-sample text; it defines no event and estimates no payoff
next_action.financial_claim_blocker: any financial claim needs OOS replication (in-sample hypotheses do not need OOS to be reported honestly, but replication does) plus a non-classifier JEV mechanism not currently demonstrated
